newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss franc bonds closed steady to barely firmer at the end of a quiet week as customers continued to stay away, traders said.
Traders said many invetsors were lured away by a strong Swiss stock market, which closed with a third consecutive record high.
There were no jolts to the market from the econony and even higher than expected German M3 money supply figures did not pressure prices.
One trader cited uncertainty about how currency markets would develop the next time dollar or Euro issues erupt again.
The biggest volume was in federal bonds, although there was also demand for issues from major Swiss companies such as the 3-3/4 percent Swiss Reinsurance 2007, traders said.
Euro Swiss francs up nine at 98.62
